# uptimeify_organization (Data Source)

The token's own organization (`GET /api/organization`). Billing, address, quota and MFA fields are only filled for admin tokens.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uptimeify_organization" "this" {}

output "organization_name" {
  value = data.uptimeify_organization.this.name
}
```
